description: This file contains API service functions for managing extender device settings, status, scanning, and WPS actions, including mock data for development and real API calls.

methods.name: getExtenderStatus
methods.description: Fetches the current extender status, returning mock data in development or calling the API in production.

methods.name: updateExtenderSettings
methods.description: Updates extender settings, modifying mock data in development or sending a POST request in production.

methods.name: scanNeighborAPs
methods.description: Triggers a scan for neighboring access points, returning mock results in development or calling the API in production.

methods.name: connectToAP
methods.description: Connects the extender to a specified access point, updating mock data in development or calling the API in production.

methods.name: triggerWPS
methods.description: Triggers WPS setup on the extender, returning mock data in development or calling the API in production.
